def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    # Normalize sex case variant
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace('FEMALE', 'female')
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Filter to valid body_mass_g range and non-missing sex
    df = df[(df['sex'].notna()) & (df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return result.to_dict()
